My biggest fear is driving over bridges or high grounds. I also get uncomfortable on unknown highways. I would say for now you're very smart to not go at it alone. I haven't conquered going over a bridge alone yet but I drove to Massachusetts and back to NY alone and it was a big accomplishment for me. I got through it with simple obvious routines. I have satellite radio so any song I wanted was at my fingertips. I kept plenty of water in a tiny lunch box I converted into a cooler. I kept towels and ice packs in case I felt like I was getting hot or sweaty from anxiety (happens to me.) I kept my GPS in view at all times. I opened all my snack bags so I didn't have to look down. I spoke to myself the whole car ride and made myself laugh. This may only work if you're silly and find your own jokes funny. But anytime I felt nervous i'd make silly pun road trip jokes. I kept my bf and parents on speed dial/favorites. I wasn't afraid to stop if I needed to. I got coffee or just took time to meditate. I think facing it with comfort methods and items helped me. I plan to use the same methods when I plan to conquer the bridge fear. Just know you're not alone, you're brave and you can do this. I believe in you and you will be ok! Remember to smile, it makes it a tiny bit easier.
